description: This file defines a set of locator generator classes and functions for different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, JSONL) used in the Playwright testing framework. It includes logic for parsing selectors, generating locators, and handling various locator options and types.

classes.name: JavaScriptLocatorFactory
classes.description: Locator factory for JavaScript, generating locator strings with specific syntax.

classes.name: PythonLocatorFactory
classes.description: Locator factory for Python, generating locator strings with specific syntax.

classes.name: JavaLocatorFactory
classes.description: Locator factory for Java, generating locator strings with specific syntax.

classes.name: CSharpLocatorFactory
classes.description: Locator factory for C#, generating locator strings with specific syntax.

classes.name: JsonlLocatorFactory
classes.description: Locator factory for JSONL, serializing locators as JSON objects.

methods.name: generateLocator
methods.description: Generates a locator string based on base, type, body, and options for each language-specific factory.

methods.name: chainLocators
methods.description: Chains multiple locators into a single string or JSON structure.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a RegExp instance.

methods.name: detectExact
methods.description: Detects if a string represents an exact match pattern and returns the pattern with an 'exact' flag.
